plan.thoughts: Monday has two fixed Seahawks games, so those rooms anchor the afternoon and evening. The fan groups are built around real sports fans plus craft-beer lovers. The rest of the day is spread across many different people. Mornings go to quieter outdoor and food rooms: Franklin history and photography hikers, older birders, a fishing trio, and parents with kids who bake at the bakery. Afternoons hold a mixed-age cribbage table and a gentle Franklin history walk for three neighbors around 80. Evenings bring a pickleball doubles foursome finished early for those who avoid late nights, and a Ten Trails walk for keen hikers and runners in their late 50s. I checked the fixed game times against what people avoid and kept anyone who avoids late nights or early mornings out of conflicting slots.
